contract: Successful parsing is required before acquiring the mutex.
State changes and any i2c_w_bits update occur while the mutex is held.
For out-of-range input, the state is cleared and a log is emitted while locked, with no bus update.
Parser-error path never acquires the mutex or queues work.

evidence.locator: lock 0x4100; unlock 0x4154; queue_work_on 0x4164; error return path 0x4198-0x41c0

unknowns: Removal/teardown synchronization and whether queued work is drained are not established here.
